culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: At Ise Jingu purify hands and mouth at the temizusha, then pray with two bows, two claps and one bow. No eating, drinking or smoking except in designated areas.
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: No photography at the prayer area in front of the main sanctuaries. Hours: 5am to 5pm October to December, 5am to 6pm January to April and September, 5am to 7pm May to August.

laws.rule: Mie Youth Healthy Development Ordinance (三重県青少年健全育成条例), art. 19. The ordinance sets the late-night period as 10 pm to 5 am. A guardian is required (not only asked) to see that a young person (generally under 18) is not out in that period without good reason. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The offence for others carries a fine of up to JPY 100,000 (about A$902). Rates: RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82.

festivals.what: Kannamesai (Ise Jingu): 15 to 25 October each year, the shrine's harvest thanksgiving; the main rites are at the Geku on 15 and 16 October and the Naiku on 16 and 17 October, including night and 2 am offerings. The shrine notes events can change.
